parts.text:
Ticket 1 covers the backend endpoints and database queries for cancelling registrations and updating capacity, the frontend view and API client for member seat release actions, the backend meetup tests validating the criteria, and the README documenting seat return behaviour.
Ticket 2 encompasses the backend routes and database queries to fetch attendee names conditionally by organiser role, the frontend view and API client to render attendees privately, the backend meetup tests covering privacy rules, and the README documenting organiser attendee lists.
